t: You're at Warwick Square, a garden square in Pimlico. The church in the square, St Gabriel's, is listed Grade II star, and the other buildings facing the square are Grade II listed. The private gardens at the centre are also Grade II listed. Two people are linked to the square. Katharine Macmillan, Viscountess Macmillan of Ovenden, lived here. She was a daughter-in-law of Prime Minister Harold Macmillan, and a granddaughter of the fourth Marquess of Salisbury. Mary Parker, a botanical collector, died here.
